Translate a dashboard text key

Source: R/i18n.R
episodic_tr.Rd

Looks up a piece of dashboard text by its key and language, substituting any {placeholder} tokens in the template. Mostly useful if you are writing your own Quarto outbreak report template (EPISODIC_QUARTO_REPORT) and want it to read the same wording, in the same language, as the dashboard itself.

Usage

episodic_tr(
  key,
  ...,
  lang = Sys.getenv("EPISODIC_LANGUAGE"),
  instance_i18n = NULL
)

Arguments

key

A dotted key identifying the piece of text, e.g. "nav.clusters". The full set of available keys and their wording in every shipped language lives in inst/i18n/*.json (one file per language: en, ar, nl, fr, de, hi, zh, es).

...

Named values substituted into {name} placeholders in the template.

lang

Language: "en", "ar", "nl", "fr", "de", "hi", "zh", or "es". Defaults to the EPISODIC_LANGUAGE environment variable, falling back to "en" if that is unset.

instance_i18n

An optional named character vector of your own wording overrides (key -> template), checked before the shipped translations. NULL (the default) uses only the shipped text.

Value

A single character string.

Examples

episodic_tr("nav.clusters", lang = "nl")
#> [1] "Clusters"
episodic_tr("nav.clusters", lang = "en")
#> [1] "Clusters"
